info.title: LSEG World-Check One API
info.description:
The World-Check One API enables developers to integrate the next generation of LSEG screening capabilities into existing workflows and internal systems (such as CRMs) in order to help streamline the processes for on-boarding, KYC and third party due diligence.
The API provides, among other features:
- The ability to screen entity names, with or without secondary fields such as date of birth for individuals. These names are called “cases” within the World-Check One system.
- The ability to retrieve results of the screening process from the World-Check database.
- The ability to flag cases for Ongoing Screening, and retrieve the World-Check results from the Ongoing Screening process.

head.summary: Check if a given 'caseId' is available for use.
head.description:
The 'caseIds' must be unique within each Client. If any Group under a Client has a Case with a particular 'caseId',
that 'caseId' cannot be reused on another Case within the same Client. This endpoint allows the User to check
if a given 'caseId' is available to use when creating or updating a Case.

**Note:** Ensure that endpoint URL is encoded if there are any special characters in caseId."*" is a wildcard character that is automatically added to the given case id as this allows using special characters such as slash (/) within the case id - which is otherwise not allowed in the path parameters.

200.description:
The given 'caseId' is in use within the current user's Client, therefore is not available to use on a
different Case.

404.description:
The given 'caseId' is not found within the current user's Client, therefore is available to use as a 'caseId'
on any Case.

post.summary: Maintain client-watchlist data.
post.description:
Maintain your Watchlist data using the following supported entity actions.

* entityCreateOrUpdate - Add a new entity to your Watchlist or replace if it already exists.

* entityDelete - Mark the given entity as deleted in your Watchlist.

* entitySupersede - Supersede enables you to redirect matches against your superseded entity to a new entity. This
is useful if you want to redirect users with existing matches against an old entity to a newer / more accurate
version of those entities.

* entityPurge - Purge enables you to remove an entity as required by GDPR whereby the personally identifiable
information is removed.

Due to the large number of entries within a Watchlist it is not possible to update the entire Watchlist in a single request
The overall request must be split into blocks of up to 500 individual entity actions.


The response consists of a list of any entities which were not successfully processed and a reason for failure.

**Note:** The client watchlist record may not be considered for re-screening if the 'modificationDate' field 
          has not been specified while modifying the record.

requestBody.description: A collection of maintenance actions to be performed on your Watchlist.

201.description: Request to maintain Watchlist data has succeeded. Please review the contents of WatchlistResponse errors for details on any individual entity actions which were not successful.

post.summary: Save and Screen a Case
post.description:
This endpoint creates and screens new cases. Cases can be screened by using two modes in query parameter ?screen=SYNC/ASYNC:

* ASYNC: Case is created and automatically added to an asynchronous screening queue. The response includes only Case details. To check screening progress, use `POST /cases/screening-status` endpoint. To check match results, use POST `/cases/{caseSystemId}/results`.
* SYNC:  Case is created and screened synchronously. The response includes case details as well as match results.

**Note:**
- Only SYNC option should be used for ZFS screening.
- In names and secondary fields where free text is allowed, any symbol is allowed except control characters like '\n' (new line) and '\t' (tab). Additionally, using operator words even when combined with an apostrophe, for example the below combinations, may cause an error 403 to be returned.
    - String ‘AND (String)
    - String ‘OR (String)
    - String ‘AND NOT (String)
    - String ‘OR NOT (String)
    - String ‘AND AS (String)
    - String ‘OR AS (String)

post.summary: Search for cases based on specified criteria.
post.description:
Search for Cases based on specified criteria using filter or query parameters.

This endpoint allows you to find cases that match your search criteria. 
You can provide these criteria in the request, which includes 'query' and 'filter' fields. 
The 'query' field is associated with a search mode, see 'TextSearchMode' for more information.

**Note:**
1. 'FILTER' types only accept exact pre-defined values in a search e.g. lifecycleState==Archived.
2. 'QUERY' types accept free text searches and also support wildcard searches for the DEFAULT search mode.

Expressions in 'query' and 'filter' must adhere to the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL), 
which is documented in [RFC 4288](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4288) and the superset supported by the WC1 API, 
as documented in [WC1 API Query Language](https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser).

To learn about the available search fields and their usage, you can use the `GET /references/search-filters` .

Response details can be customized using the 'detailLevel' field:
  - 'CASE': The search response will provide full Case details.
  - 'CASE_AND_RESULTS': The search response will include Сase details and Result summary related to this Case.
  - 'CASE_AND_AGGREGATED_RESULTS': The search response will provide full Case details with an aggregated Result summary, summarizing data from primary and sub-cases.
  - 'CASE_AND_RESULTS_AND_AGGREGATED_RESULTS': The search response will provide full Case details with a Result and aggregated(summarizing data from primary and sub-cases) summaries.

Number of results can be controlled through 'pagination' and 'sort' fields. The maximum items per page allowed as part of pagination is 100.

requestBody.description: The request containing search criteria.

200.description: A set of Cases that match the specified criteria.

patch.summary: Partial update an existing case by its caseSystemId.
patch.description:
Updates an existing Case identified by the given caseSystemId. When the Case needs to be updated, only necessary field(s) need to be sent. 
There is a query parameter with the PATCH endpoint ?screen=NONE/ASYNC/SYNC/DELTA_SYNC, which allows different results to be shown:

* NONE: Pure update; no screening by default.
* ASYNC: Update; and a screening request is added automatically to a queue for asynchronous screening and
         response contains only Case details and no results.You may use POST /cases/screening-status endpoint to check for the screening status and POST /cases/{caseSystemId}/results to retrieve the updated results. You may also use this option to just fully re-screen the case asynchronously without giving any request payload if you do not want to update the case.
* SYNC: Update; and fully re-screen the case synchronously against full data with the match results in response. You may also use this option to just fully re-screen the case synchronously without giving any request payload if you do not want to update the case.
* DELTA_SYNC: Update; and delta screen the case synchronously against new and updated data from the last screened date. Example: If case was last screened on 01-Feb-2025, using DELTA_SYNC will screen the case against new and updated data since 01-Feb-2025 until the current day.You may also use this option to just perform delta screening on the case without giving any request payload if you do not want to update the case.

**Note:**
  1. The maximum number of screenings (including full screens and re-screens) that a client can perform in an hour is limited.
  2. When updating an existing Case with Passport-Check details via the API, to check the details in the UI, you must refresh the page to view all updated details.
  3. Give "null" in the applicable fields if you want to remove the respective data from the case details.
  4. *caseResultsSummary* object is returned in the response only for the query parameter with SYNC option.

requestBody.description: Update Case payload.

200.description: Case updated.

The information provided will include simple summaries of the single case or an aggregated summary (current case plus any linked cases).
The counts provided are :
- split by resolution per source
- split for Watchlist records by resolution by sub category

**Note:** A delay of up to 40s after Case is screened is recommended while fetching full Case details with
          aggregated summaries, although a delay of up to 5s would work in most of the cases. If aggregated
          summaries return nil stats, a responsible retry mechanism with a maximum of five retries is
          recommended for the Cases where stats are expected.

get.summary: Get linked cases for a given case.
get.description:
Retrieve the list of Cases linked to the specified Case.

Link type examples:

 * `primary-to-subcase` : declares `caseSystemId` as a primary Case and lists Cases linked to it with
                          `primary-to-subcase` link type.
 * `subcase-to-primary` : declares `caseSystemId` as a subcase and lists Cases linked to it with
                          `subcase-to-primary` link type.

parameters.name: linkType
parameters.description: Link type between Cases. Multiple comma separated values allowed.

200.description: Response containing the list of relationships between cases

post.summary: Link cases to a given case.
post.description:
Create or delete links between Cases based on link type strategy (`linkType`). You can link / unlink cases in two ways:

 * `primary-to-subcase` : declares `caseSystemId` as a primary case and cases listed in `linkedCasesRequest`
                          as subcases which will be linked to / unlinked from a primary case.
 * `subcase-to-primary` : declares `caseSystemId` as a subcase and cases listed in `linkedCasesRequest`
                          as primary cases which will be linked to / unlinked from a subcase.

**Note:** There is a maximum number of World-Check One links between cases:
* Maximum 500 primary cases are allowed per a subcase.
* Maximum 50 subcases are allowed per a primary case.

**Example HTTP request**

```
    {
      "linkedCases":[
        "Case System ID 1",
        "Case System ID 2",
      ]
    }
```

requestBody.description: The payload for linked cases request.

201.description: Links between cases have been created.

204.description: Links between cases have been deleted.

The User must be active and have the move Cases between Groups Permission and must be a member of both the original group and the group the Cases are to be moved to.
The current Group and the destination Group should contain identical custom fields.

A list of failed cases only will be displayed under the summary - showing the "caseSytemId" , "caseId " has not been moved because it does not meet the validation criteria "error" and "cause" fields contain detailed information on the error.

post.summary: Submit request for async report based on the given query and filter conditions.
post.description:
Submit request for async report based on the query and filter criteria/conditions. 

This endpoint allows you to submit async request for the report generation using 
the query and filter conditions. User can submit the async request through the
request object, which includes 'query', 'filter', 'reportFilter', 'customAttributes'
fields. The 'query' field is associated with a search mode. For more details,
refer to the 'TextSearchMode' field in async report request.

- 'FILTER' types only accept exact pre-defined values in a search. e.g. lifecycleState==Archived.
- 'QUERY' types accept free text searches and also support wildcard searches for the DEFAULT search mode.

Expressions in 'query', 'filter', 'reportFilter', 'customAttributes' must adhere to the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL), 
which is documented in [RFC 4288](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4288) and the superset supported by the WC1 API, 
as documented in [WC1 API Query Language](https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser).

**Note:** 
- To learn about the available search fields and their usage, you can use the `GET /references/search-filters` endpoint.
- The CaseDossier PDF report supports processing a maximum of 500 cases at a time. If this limit is exceeded, the client will not be able to export the report. 
- A delay of up to 40s after Case is screened is recommended while submitting a request to generate the report, although a delay of up to 5s would work in most of the cases.
  If the report status is FAILED with error "No case(s) found for the given search criteria", a responsible retry mechanism with a maximum of five retries is recommended.

requestBody.description: The payload for async report request.

200.description: The response to async report request returns the request details and report ID.

- IN_PROGRESS - Report generation is in progress.
- FAILED - Report failed to generate.
- WAITING - Report is waiting in queue and yet to be processed.
- UNKNOWN - Report status is unknown.
- CANCELLED - Report request has been cancelled.

**NOTE**: Generated case dossier report via `POST /reports` endpoint will only be available upto 3 days from the date of generation.

post.summary: Get ongoing screening updates.
post.description:
Get ongoing screening updates for all `Case` objects that are visible to the current user and are flagged for
ongoing screening.

User can submit ongoing screening updates request through the request object, 
which includes 'filter' and 'matchFilter' fields. Expressions in 'filter' and 'matchFilter' must adhere to the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL), 
which is documented in [RFC 4288](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4288) and the superset supported by the WC1 API, 
as documented in [WC1 API Query Language](https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser). This endpoint will provide last 30 days of ongoing screening updates.

Ongoing screening updates are available in two modes. i.e.FULL or SUMMARY mode. The maximum items per page allowed as part of pagination is 1000.

e.g.1. Filter body that specifies the items per page to be `1000` and queries the first page of ongoing screening updates
for WATCHLIST and MEDIA_CHECK provider types occurred from `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z` to `2023-01-30T23:59:59Z`, sorted by
`updateDate` in `ASCENDING` order with SUMMARY mode:


 ```

    - ONGOING_SCREENING_UPDATES with SUMMARY Mode
    {
        "filter": "updateDate=RANGE=(2023-01-01T00:00:00Z,2023-01-30T23:59:59Z);providerType=in=('MEDIA_CHECK','WATCHLIST');groupId=='groupId1';caseSystemId=='caseSystemId1'",
        "pagination": {
          "itemsPerPage": 1000,
          "pageReference": "Reference ID of the requested page"
        },
        "mode": "SUMMARY",
        "sort": [
          {
            "columnName": "updateDate",
            "order": "ASCENDING"
          }
        ]
    }
 ```

e.g.2. Filter body that specifies the items per page to be `1000` and queries the first page of ongoing screening updates
for WATCHLIST and MEDIA_CHECK provider types and specified groupId, occurred from `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z` to 
`2023-01-30T23:59:59Z`, sorted by `updateDate` in `ASCENDING` order along with match filters applied 
by resolutionStatus, reviewRequired updates for specified caseSystemId in FULL mode:


```
  - ONGOING_SCREENING_UPDATES with FULL Mode
  {
    "filter": "updateDate=RANGE=(2023-01-01T00:00:00Z,2023-01-30T23:59:59Z);providerType=in=('MEDIA_CHECK','WATCHLIST');groupId=='groupId1';resultType=='UPDATED';caseSystemId=='caseSystemId1'",
    "matchFilter": "resolutionStatus=in=('POSITIVE','POSSIBLE','UNSPECIFIED','FALSE');reviewRequired=='FALSE'"
    "pagination": {
      "itemsPerPage": 1000,
      "pageReference": "Reference ID of the requested page"
    },
    "mode": "FULL",
    "sort": [
      {
        "columnName": "updateDate",
        "order": "ASCENDING"
      }
    ]
  }
```

requestBody.description: Filter and sort the ongoing screening updates in the response.

200.description: Ongoing screening update search response.

AbstractCaseSearchModel.description:
Request model used to search within, sort across, paginate through, and filter down the set of Cases.

A model contains 'query', 'filter' expression, which is written in a superset of the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL).

The FIQL is documented in <https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-nottingham-atompub-fiql-00>,
and the superset supported by the WC1 API documented in <https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser>.

RSQL/FIQL parser contains some reserved characters:

`'"' | "'" | "(" | ")" | ";" | "," | "=" | "!" | "~" | "<" | ">"`

If there are reserved characters or white spaces in the query expression, they must be escaped by enclosing 
them in single or double quotes. If you need to use both single and double quotes inside an argument, then
you must escape one of them using `\` (backslash). If you want to use `\` literally, then double it as `\\`.
Backslash has a special meaning only inside a quoted argument, not in unquoted argument. Using reserved 
characters or white spaces without escaping can lead to parsing and execution errors.

The query examples:

* "query": "example=='TE!ST'"
* "query": "example==\\"TE'ST\\""
* "query": "example=='TE\\\\'ST'"

Argument can be a single value, or multiple values in parenthesis separated by comma. Value that does not
contain any reserved character or a white space can be unquoted, other arguments must be enclosed in single 
or double quotes.

Example:

* "query": "example1=='TE\\\\'ST', example2==TEST"

query.description:
A string containing the search query.

This is associated with the 'searchMode' field. 
The entered search mode applies to all the fields in the query, but with the following rules being applied:

 - primaryName - supports all search modes
 - caseId - supports all search modes
 - idNumbersValue - uses EXACT matches for DEFAULT, CONTAINS and EXACT search modes, otherwise allows BEGINS_WITH search mode
 - customFieldsValue - uses BEGINS_WITH searches for DEFAULT and BEGINS_WITH search modes, also supports CONTAINS and EXACT search modes

**Note:** To find the available search fields, check for fields with 'QUERY' type in the `GET /references/search-filters` endpoint.

**Note:** To find the available search fields, check for fields with 'FILTER' type in the `GET /references/search-filters` endpoint.

- creationDate=RANGE=("2025-02-01T22:21:21.222Z","2025-03-01T22:21:21.222Z")
- creationDate=RANGE=("2025-02-01","2025-03-01")

Above example can be used for any Date filters like modificationDate,lastScreenedDate,creationDate etc.

AsyncReportRequest.description:
Request model used to search within, sort across and filter down the data for async report generation.
This request object contains 'query', 'filter', 'reportFilter', 'customAttributes' expression,
which is written in a superset of the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL).

query.description:
The query string used for fetching the source data for the report. Query is associated with the 'searchMode' field.
The entered search mode applies to all the fields in the query, but with the following rules being applied:

- **primaryName** - Supports all search modes.
- **caseId** - Supports all search modes.
- **idNumbersValue** - Uses EXACT matches for DEFAULT, CONTAINS and EXACT search modes, otherwise allows BEGINS_WITH search mode.

**Note:** 
- To find the available search fields, check for fields with 'QUERY' type in the `GET /references/search-filters` endpoint.
- The 'QUERY' expression can include a maximum of 10 caseId's in searching criteria.
- To submit an async report request, either the 'query' or 'filter' criteria is mandatory. 
  If the report type is UBO_REPORT, either 'caseId' in 'query' or 'caseSystemId' in 'filter' must be provided.

filter.description:
The filters to be applied on the dataset returned by using the query. 

**Note:** 
- To find the available filter fields, check for fields with 'FILTER' type in the `GET /references/search-filters` endpoint.
- The 'FILTER' expression can include a maximum of 10 caseSystemId's in searching criteria.
- To submit an async report request, either the 'query' or 'filter' criteria is mandatory. 
  If the report type is UBO_REPORT, either 'caseId' in 'query' or 'caseSystemId' in 'filter' must be provided.

reportName.description: Name for the report. If not provided, system will generate the name for the report based on the type of report.

reportFilter.description:
The filters to be applied on the record level dataset.

The reportFilter supports below fields to specify searching criteria with respect to **Case Dossier Report**:
- **providerType**: Array of provider types used in record level filtration and does not have default providerType value. The list of supported providerTypes are:
  - WATCHLIST
  - CLIENT_WATCHLIST

- **includeUnresolvedMatches**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includePositiveMatches**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includePossibleMatches**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includeFalseMatches**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includeUnspecifiedMatches**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includeAudit**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is true.

- **includePassportCheck**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includeMediaCheckFullArticles**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

- **includeMediaCheckHeadlines**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration and default value is false.

**Note:** The record filters – 'includeUnresolvedMatches', 'includePositiveMatches', 'includePossibleMatches', 'includeFalseMatches' &
          'includeUnspecifiedMatches', allow for the export of the full matched records in addition to the Case Dossier Report.
          This selection does not affect the summary of all matched records included in the Case Dossier Report. 
          The other filters 'includeMediacheckHeadlines', 'includeMediacheckArticles', 'includePassportCheck' & 'includeAudit' are applicable
          for the inclusion or exclusion of these sections in the Case Dossier report.

The report Level Filter examples:

**example 1**: To generate a case dossier PDF report for the matched World-Check records with multiple record filters along with the
             additional filter sections namingly 'includePassportCheck', 'includeMediaCheckFullArticles' or 'includeMediaCheckHeadlines',
             'includeAudit'.

- "reportFilter": "(includeUnresolvedMatches==true; includePositiveMatches==true; includePossibleMatches==true;
   includeFalseMatches==true; includeUnspecifiedMatches==true; providerType==WATCHLIST),
   (includePassportCheck==true), (includeMediaCheckFullArticles==true), (includeMediaCheckHeadlines==true), 
   (includeAudit==true)"

**example 2**: To generate a case dossier PDF report for the matched World-Check or Client-Watchlist records
             with multiple record filters along with the additional filter sections namingly 'includePassportCheck',
             'includeMediaCheckFullArticles' or 'includeMediaCheckHeadlines'.

- "reportFilter": "(includeUnresolvedMatches==true; includePositiveMatches==true; includePossibleMatches==true; 
   providerType==WATCHLIST), (includeFalseMatches==true; includeUnspecifiedMatches==true; providerType==CLIENT_WATCHLIST),
   (includePassportCheck==true), (includeMediaCheckFullArticles==true), (includeMediaCheckHeadlines==true)"

**example 3**: To generate a case dossier PDF report which includes only filter sections like 'includePassportCheck',
              'includeAudit', 'includeMediaCheckFullArticles' or 'includeMediaCheckHeadlines' without the matched 
              World-Check or Client-Watchlist records.

- "reportFilter": "includePassportCheck==true, includeAudit==true, includeMediaCheckFullArticles==true, includeMediaCheckHeadlines==true"

---

The reportFilter supports below fields to specify searching criteria related to **Case Summary CSV report**:
- **includeLinkedCases**: A boolean value for record-level filtration. The default value is false.

**example**: To generate a Case Summary CSV report that includes linked cases. 

- "reportFilter": "includeLinkedCases==true"

---

The reportFilter supports below fields to specify searching criteria with respect to **Case Details CSV report**:
- **dateFilter**: used to filter records based on the date range.

- **dateRecordMatched**: represents the boolean value for record level filtration. The default value is false.

- **dateRecordLastAlerted**: represents the boolean value for record level filtration. The default value is false.

- **dateRecordLastModifiedByUser**: represents the boolean value for record level filtration. The default value is false.

**example**: To generate a Case Details CSV report by filtering matches based on the matched, alerted, and/or user-modified dates within the specified 'dateFilter',
             use filter options such as 'dateRecordMatched' or 'dateRecordLastAlerted' or 'dateRecordLastModifiedByUser'.

- "reportFilter": "dateFilter=RANGE=(2025-03-01,2025-03-31); dateRecordMatched==true; dateRecordLastAlerted==true; dateRecordLastModifiedByUser==true"

**Note:** 
- The 'dateFilter' only supports the RANGE operator without a timestamp and must follow the ISO 8601 standard.
  e.g. dateFilter=RANGE=(2025-03-01,2025-03-31).

- The 'dateFilter' is a mandatory filter when applying case filters like 'dateRecordMatched' or 'dateRecordLastAlerted' or 'dateRecordLastModifiedByUser' 
          match criteria for generating the Case Details CSV report.
---

The reportFilter supports below fields to specify searching criteria with respect to **UBO PDF report**:
- **uniqueBusinessId**: represents the String value for the record level filtration and is mandatory, if report type is UBO_REPORT.

- **beneficialOwnershipOnly**: represents the boolean value for the record level filtration.

- **ownersType**: The list of supported ownersType are:
- Individual
- Business
- Unspecified

- **beneficialOwnershipPercentage**: represents the percentage value between 0 and 100 for the record level filtration.

- **depth**: represents the integer value of 1 or greater for the record level filtration.

- **countryCode**: represents the country associated with the request which must be a three-character uppercase string for the record level filtration.

**Note:** The 'uniqueBusinessId' is a mandatory filter, if report type is UBO_REPORT to generate UBO PDF report.

**example 1**: To generate a UBO PDF report along with the 'uniqueBusinessId' and all other report filters.
- "reportFilter": "uniqueBusinessId==abcdefghijk123; beneficialOwnershipOnly==true; ownersType==Individual; beneficialOwnershipPercentage==15; depth==2; countryCode==IND"

**example 2**: To generate a UBO PDF report with the 'uniqueBusinessId'.
- "reportFilter": "uniqueBusinessId==abcdefghijk123"

A string containing filter criteria which used to query the ongoing screening updates.

The filter supports below fields to specify searching criteria:

- **updateDate**: The date and time of the ongoing screening

  e.g. `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z` (Mandatory).

- **providerType**: Provider type to query the ongoing screening results(Optional). Supports == and RANGE operator.
    The following providerTypes are allowed:
     - WATCHLIST : It includes results from both `WATCHLIST` and `CLIENT_WATCHLIST`. 
     - MEDIA_CHECK : It includes results from `MEDIA_CHECK`.

- **groupId**: Group and its respective subgroups to query the ongoing screening results(Optional). Supports == operator.
    e.g. groupId=='groupId1'

- **resultType**: Determines result set under a case which got updated. Accepts either NEW or UPDATED values(Optional). Supports == operator. Applicable for FULL mode.
    - NEW : It will return only new results under a case.
    - UPDATED : It will return only updated results under a case.

- **caseSystemId**: System generated ID for the Case to query the ongoing screening results(Optional). Supports == and IN operator.
    The maximum number of caseSystemId allowed is 50. 

    **Note:** This will also be provided as part of Notification Payload under Push Notification for OGS updates.

query.description:
A query filter expression, which is written in a superset of the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL).
The FIQL is documented in <https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-nottingham-atompub-fiql-00>,
and the superset supported by the WC1 API documented in <https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser>.

RSQL/FIQL parser contains some reserved characters:

`'"' | "'" | "(" | ")" | ";" | "," | "=" | "!" | "~" | "<" | ">"`

If there are reserved characters or white spaces in the query expression, they must be escaped by enclosing 
them in single or double quotes. If you need to use both single and double quotes inside an argument, then
you must escape one of them using `\` (backslash). If you want to use `\` literally, then double it as `\\`.
Backslash has a special meaning only inside a quoted argument, not in unquoted argument. Using reserved 
characters or white spaces without escaping can lead to parsing and execution errors.

The query examples:

* "query": "example=='TE!ST'"
* "query": "example==\\"TE'ST\\""
* "query": "example=='TE\\\\'ST'"

Argument can be a single value, or multiple values in parenthesis separated by comma. Value that does not
contain any reserved character or a white space can be unquoted, other arguments must be enclosed in single 
or double quotes.

Example:

* "query": "example1=='TE\\\\'ST', example2==TEST"

ResultsSearchModel.description:
Request model used to filter, sort and paginate the screening results of a single case.

A model contains 'query', 'filter' expression, which is written in a superset of the Atom Feed Item Query Language (FIQL).

The FIQL is documented in <https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-nottingham-atompub-fiql-00>,
and the superset supported by the WC1 API documented in <https://github.com/jirutka/rsql-parser>.

RSQL/FIQL parser contains some reserved characters:

`'"' | "'" | "(" | ")" | ";" | "," | "=" | "!" | "~" | "<" | ">"`

If there are reserved characters or white spaces in the query expression, they must be escaped by enclosing 
them in single or double quotes. If you need to use both single and double quotes inside an argument, then
you must escape one of them using `\` (backslash). If you want to use `\` literally, then double it as `\\`.
Backslash has a special meaning only inside a quoted argument, not in unquoted argument. Using reserved 
characters or white spaces without escaping can lead to parsing and execution errors.

The query examples:

* "query": "example=='TE!ST'"
* "query": "example==\\"TE'ST\\""
* "query": "example=='TE\\\\'ST'"

Argument can be a single value, or multiple values in parenthesis separated by comma. Value that does not
contain any reserved character or a white space can be unquoted, other arguments must be enclosed in single 
or double quotes.

Example:

* "query": "example1=='TE\\\\'ST', example2==TEST"

filter.description:
The filter string specifies the criteria for listing notifications.

The filter supports below fields to specify criteria:
- **updatedDate**: Represents the date and time in ISO 8601 format(excluding Week and Ordinal dates)
                   when the notification was last updated. Supports only == operator. 
                    e.g. `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z` (Mandatory).

- **recipientId**: Represents the unique recipient Id for which notifications need to be listed.
                   Supports == and IN operator. The maximum number of recipientId allowed is 50. (Mandatory) 

- **eventType**: Represents the type of event that triggered the notification. (Optional).
                 Supports == and IN operator.


- **status**: Represents the notification delivery status to the client Webhook. (Optional).
              Supports == and IN operator. The following delivery status are allowed.

    - SUCCESS : Represents the delivery of notification to webhook is successful.
    - PENDING : Represents the delivery of notification to webhook is in pending state.
    - FAILED  : Represents the delivery of notification to webhook is in failed state.

- 'eventType'   - Represents the type of event that triggered the notification.
- 'status'      - Represents the notification delivery status to the client Webhook.

Thus the Global Ultimate of this family tree (and therefore of each member of the family tree) is Company D.

The 'Entity' subclasses corresponding to each type of Entity (designated by the 'entityType' field below) are:

* 'INDIVIDUAL' : 'IndividualEntity'
* 'ORGANISATION' : 'OrganisationEntity'
* 'VESSEL' : 'VesselEntity'

* to add Date of Birth to an Individual entity, please use the 'events' array with the "type":"BIRTH"
* to add Place of Birth to an Individual entity, please use the 'events' array with the "type":"BIRTH" and populate the 'Region' field as part of the event 'address' object
* to add Registered Country to a Vessel entity, please use  the 'countryLinks' array with the "type":"VESSELFLAG"
* to add Registered Country to an Organisation entity, please use the 'countryLinks' array with the "type": "REGISTEREDIN"

SubscriptionAuth.description:
Generic authentication model of the subscription. Authentication model currently supports HMAC and OAUTH.
The SubscriptionAuth contains the url, authType, credentials for respective authentication models.

For hmac authentication, Credentials contains following parameters: 
- apiKey
- apiSecret

For oauth authentication, Credentials contains following parameters:
- clientId
- clientSecret
- tokenUrl

url.description:
Represents the Webhook endpoint url, where notifications needs to be delivered.

**Note:** IP based urls are not supported. It should be a FQDN (url Schema should be "https" only). Port is not allowed in url. Your Webhook service should have a certificate provided by a well known CA. URLs with Self signed and privately signed certificates will not be allowed.

apiKey.description: Represents unique api key for Subscription hmac authentication.

apiSecret.description: Represents unique client secret for Subscription hmac authentication.

clientId.description: Represents a unique public identifier for client token url. It’s used to identify the application making the request for oauth authentication.

clientSecret.description: Represents unique confidential string known only to the application and the authorization server for oauth authentication.

tokenUrl.description:
Token URL is used by the client application to exchange an authorization code or client credentials for an access token in oauth authentication.

**Note:** IP based urls are not supported. It should be a FQDN (url Schema should be "https" only). Port is not allowed in url. Your Webhook service should have a certificate provided by a well known CA. URLs with Self signed and privately signed certificates will not be allowed.

SubscriptionStatus.description:
Represents the status of the subscription request. One among
- ACTIVE - The subscription has passed the verification and is active.
- VERIFICATION_PENDING - The subscription request has been successful however the webhook verification could not be completed (due to 504 https Gateway Timeout response).
- VERIFICATION_FAILED - The subscription request has been successful however the webhook verification has failed  (due to any non 504 https response).
- INACTIVE - The subscription has been made inactive by the user. For inactive subscription, notification will not be sent.
- SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS - An intermediate status for patch to avoid simultaneous update requests.

reason.description: Reason indicates the error code and cause for the VERIFICATION_FAILED or VERIFICATION_PENDING status of subscription. For the active subscription, reason will not be populated.

UpdateSubscriptionStatus.description:
Subscription status can be updated either from ACTIVE to INACTIVE or INACTIVE to ACTIVE status.

**Note:**
- Whenever subscription needs to be updated with INACTIVE status, only the subscriptionStatus field is allowed in the request payload.
- Whenever subscription will be updated from INACTIVE status to ACTIVE status, verification of Subscription Auth will be re-triggered.

TextSearchMode.description:
The search mode for case search query fields. 
The following search types are available:

* DEFAULT: Searches for the words in the search string in any order.  
   e.g. Searching for "smith fred" would match a case name of "fred james smith". 
   Supports wildcard searches using the * and ? characters:
     * " * " : matches zero or more characters. e.g. "*ed j*es sm*" would match "fred james smith".
     * " ? " : matches one character. e.g. "fr?d" would match "fred" but not "freed".

* BEGINS_WITH: The text to be searched must begin with the search string. 
   e.g. Searching for "fred ja" would match a case name of "fred james smith".
   Does not support wildcard searches.

* EXACT: The text to be searched must exactly match the search string. 
   e.g. Searching for "fred james smith" would match a case name of "fred james smith".
   Does not support wildcard searches.

* CONTAINS: The text must contain all the words in the search string in the same order.
   e.g. Searching for "james smith" or "fred james" would match a case name of "fred james smith".
   Does not support wildcard searches.
